February 5, 1979 


SPECIAL KA-NEWS 


Dear Kanawana Staff Member: 


It ts not without sadness that | write this, my last 
letter to you as director of Kamp Kanawana. As of today's 
date, | have resigned from the Montreal YMCA. | will be 
assuming a similar post with the Victoria YM-YWCA in mid- 
March. 


Regretably | am unable to contact you all individually. 
Nevertheless, |! express my gratitude for your work, 
cooperation and understanding through my six years at 
K.K. | shall always cherish with fondness, the memories 
of Kamp and you, the staff that helped make It happen. 


You may be wondering about K.K. '79. Hopefully the 

good things that have happened In the past will continue 
this year. Any camp needs continulty of staff and thus 
my leaving should not discourage you from applying for 

a position at Kanawana this summer. With your help, 
Kamp will continue with much success. 


If you are ever in Victoria, do drop by the Y. There 
will always be a coffee for a visiting Kanawantan. 


My best wishes to you all for much peace and joy - 
now and in your future. 


Yours In Kamping, 


Derek V. Walsh, 
Director. 


DVW/h
